scripts.build: npm run build -w @hashroll/fair && npm run build -w @hashroll/program && npm run build -w @hashroll/api && npm run build -w @hashroll/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @hashroll/fair && npm test -w @hashroll/program && npm test -w @hashroll/api
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @hashroll/fair && npm run build -w @hashroll/program
scripts.build:program: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD/solana":/work -w /work -v hashroll-cargo:/root/.cargo/registry -v hashroll-solcache:/root/.cache/solana solanafoundation/anchor:v0.32.1 bash scripts/anchor-build.sh
scripts.deploy:local: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --network hashroll_default -v "$PWD/solana":/work -w /work solanafoundation/anchor:v0.32.1 solana program deploy target/deploy/hashroll.so --program-id keys/dev/program.json --keypair keys/dev/admin.json --url http://solana:8899 && npm run bootstrap:local -w @hashroll/program
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run start:dev -w @hashroll/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @hashroll/web
